To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the TCE dimensions of frequency, uncertainty and asset specificity are associated with the quality attributes that are most likely to drive client satisfaction in the five commonly outsourced services: applications, data center, help desk, network, and EUC.
the quality of outsourced services is determined by transaction cost characteristics of the service and by the attributes of quality.

(1) the quality of outsourced services is determined by the TCE characteristics, (2) different TCE characteristics drive client satisfaction with different services, and (3) the drivers of client satisfac-tion with a service are different from the drivers of client dissatisfaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: what drives client satisfaction with outsourced services?
the quality of IT services and how it relates to TCE characteristics.

the following: (a) understanding how the TCE characteristics influence client perceptions of the quality of the service and (b) understanding how the service quality, in turn, influences client satisfaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the TCE framework provides a basis for understanding client satisfaction with IT outsourcing, and that the TCE attributes are a good starting point for developing a theory of client satisfaction with IT services.
the attributes that drive client satisfaction with IT outsourcing services depend on the TCE characteristics (frequency, uncertainty, and specificity) of the services.
the TCE framework can be a useful tool for IT outsourcing managers to understand the drivers of client service satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TCE approach is a powerful tool to understand and predict service quality in outsourced IT services.
the attributes that drive satisfaction in a particular service vary according to the TCE characteristics that define the service.
we found the relationship between TCE characteristics of a service and service quality to be complex and non-linear.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TCE framework can provide guidance for service providers on how to manage client satisfaction.
the TCE framework can help managers understand the drivers of client IT service satisfaction, and thereby improve client satisfaction and IT service delivery.
the quality of IT services is not a single, monolithic construct.
